test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Famous 'Sangai Festival' is an annual cultural festival organized by which state of North-East India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Manipur__.**

__
 
• **The Famous 'Sangai Festival' is an annual cultural festival organized by Manipur state of North-East India.**__

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Sangai festival** is an annual cultural festival organized by the **Manipur Tourism Department every year from 21 to 30 November.**
 
• The **festival** is named after the **state animal 'Sangai' the brown antlered deer.**
 
• Many folk dance performances like **Bamboo dance, Maibi dance are performed.**
 
• '**Ras Leela**' is an important form of dance performance at the festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
